name: pages-native
description: Native Apple Pages with guarded edits, guided templates, batch generation and local recipe history.

interface.longDescription: Native .pages documents, structured search, guarded text and typed table edits, reusable model recipes, batches of up to 10 new documents, recipe history with saved prototypes and restoration, objects, explicit exports and PDF/PNG previews. Requires macOS, Apple Pages, Node.js 22+ and Automation permission. No Accessibility or Word conversion backend. Named paragraph styles and chart series editing are not exposed.
defaultPrompt: Create a native Pages report and show its PDF preview.
Preview a text replacement in this Pages document while preserving surrounding formatting.
